kevin (AE): Heads-up: inbound lift-and-shift POC for FinLedger. They're asking for a dedicated capacity recommendation for an initial 3-week pilot. Traffic sketch: peak ~250 RPS sustained for embeddings+generation, short bursts to ~500 RPS for ~2h/day. Need guidance on reserved GPUs, autoscale policy, preheat, and any pricing delta if we suggest hybrid spot for burst pool. cc @ana @mike

ana (Solutions): Thanks — can you paste the traffic profile (avg seq length, prompt vs completion split, embeddings QPS)?

kevin (AE): Avg total seq ~120 tokens (prompt+response). Mix is roughly 60% generation calls, 40% embedding requests. Embedding calls are shorter but high QPS. Latency SLO: 500ms p95 for generation. Model: customer plans to run an open 13B quantized variant.

mike (Sales Eng): For that profile, a conservative starting point is 4 reserved A100-equiv GPUs with a 2-GPU burst pool. Autoscale rules: scale on queue depth + p95 latency, scale-up quicker than scale-down. Preheat: warm KV cache + one rolling model warmup window before business hours.

sudha (SRE): Operational caveats: if burst pool uses spot, require AZ-fallback and a model-variant fallback (e.g., fallback to 6-bit quantized smaller model) to avoid p95 blowups when spot is reclaimed. Ensure prefix KV caching is enabled for embeddings.

linda (Finance): Quick note on pricing: reserved capacity is quoted per-GPU/month (we'll attach numbers in the SOW). Spot burst credits are cheaper but not SLA-backed — legal wants an explicit worst-case billing scenario surfaced.

ana (Solutions): Rough config suggestion to put in the proposal:
```yaml
reserved_gpus: 4
burst_pool:
  size: 2
  type: spot
autoscale:
  primary_metric: p95_latency_ms
  scale_up_threshold: 400
  scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
preheat_window_minutes: 15
fallback_policy:
  model_variant: smaller-6bit
  fallover_to_cpu: true
```

kevin (AE): Customer also sent a security questionnaire. They require data residency controls and KMS-backed encryption. This will be deployed in a Private VPC. Any blockers for Private install within the requested timeline?

sudha (SRE): No hard blockers, but for Private we need KMS/HSM integration and network peering completed. Leave ~2 weeks runway for certs and customer scoping. Add canary rollout for the model and an explicit auto-failover policy to avoid cross-AZ mass failovers.

mike (Sales Eng): :thumbsup: I'll draft the capacity section of the SOW including: reserved baseline, spot burst mechanics, autoscale thresholds, preheat plan, and fallback paths (quantized variant + CPU fallback). Recommend we include measurable SLOs and a small runbook for failovers.

ana (Solutions): Also enable token-level cost reporting and trace hooks in Redwood Console for the eval team — helps justify the reserved commit to procurement.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: preheat job scheduled for 2025-03-14T08:45Z

kevin (AE): Great. Can we do a 30-min sync tomorrow to align on SOW language and sketch the pricing appendix? I'll loop in legal and FinLedger infra. Thanks everyone!
__note: Per agents.md: single Slack thread as continuous string with messages prefixed by sender. No title field included.
